row.evidence: Checkr's SSO help article says 'Checkr supports the standard SCIM APIs. To provision the SCIM API for your account, contact Checkr', but neither it nor the per-report pricing page says which accounts get SCIM or whether it costs extra.
row.notes: Unknown: SCIM exists (help-centre SSO article) but must be enabled by contacting Checkr, and no plan, price, endpoint or token detail is public. Pricing is per background-check report, not per seat (Basic $29.99, Essential $59.99, Complete $94.99 per report; Enterprise 'Talk to sales'), so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO is self-service in Account settings > Single Sign On with guides for Azure AD (non-gallery app), Okta (custom SAML 2.0 app) and Google Workspace (custom SAML app); no plan gate is stated. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found. The public API has a read-only GET /v1/users; users are invited and given roles in the Dashboard. The help centre (Salesforce) renders article text only for crawlers; the quotes were read from that HTML.

scim.notes: Only the one-line statement in the SSO article; enablement is by request to Checkr. No endpoint, auth or attribute documentation is public.

auth.notes: OpenAPI security scheme basic_auth (API key as username).

user_api.notes: Users can be invited and assigned roles only from the Dashboard; the API also has account Nodes (hierarchy) endpoints used for user restrictions.

okta.notes: Checkr's guide creates a custom SAML 2.0 app in Okta; https://www.okta.com/integrations/checkr/ returns 404.

entra.notes: Checkr's guide uses a non-gallery Enterprise application; no Microsoft Learn tutorial (checkr-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Workspace.

fallbacks.notes: Users are added by email invitation in the Dashboard; JIT on SAML sign-in is not documented.
